text: MV and LV protection shall be selective: MV feeders with overcurrent, sensitive earth fault and, for motors, the functions of section 8; LV feeders with breakers / fuses selective to the upstream device. Where the selectivity study shows that the switchgear internal-arc clearing time exceeds 100 ms, arc-fault detection (light plus current) with fast tripping shall be used. Switchgear shall have internal-arc classification (IAC AFLR) at the rated short-circuit current and time.
